name: Mattel Youth Ambassadors (UCLA Mattel Children's Hospital)
what_you_do: Support Mattel Children's Hospital and patient programs. You meet each week in summer and each month in the school year. You make art projects and hear from doctors. You also work toward a fundraising goal.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 16 to 18. Must be 16 by Sept 1.
pay_detail: No fee, but each ambassador must raise $1,250 for the hospital to earn an awards package.
duration: Cohort 8 runs 2027 to 2028. Meetings are Wednesdays 3:30 to 4:30 PM, virtual; weekly in summer, monthly in the school year.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran May 1 to June 6, 2026. Recruitment for Cohort 8 (2027 to 2028) is expected to open in May 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on the program page when applications reopen. The page suggests joining an information session. Questions: mya@mednet.ucla.edu.
notes: Fundraising cannot start until you are accepted. It cannot take place on hospital or clinic grounds. Two excused absences are allowed.
